note: How a Codex provider worker starts (S8-W1, CRED-5 broker-held, CAP-11). Inert until #809 qualifies the pinned CLI and agentosd registers the route. CODEX_HOME holds only the placeholder auth.json (#1015); the model base_url points at the in-worker forwarder (#1014), which the launcher starts by running wrap + argv: #1314's runner must exec wrap followed by argv with env (ASSUMPTIONS C18). The forwarder starts argv with only PATH, HOME, CODEX_HOME and GIT_DIR from env, and sets CODEX_REFRESH_TOKEN_URL_OVERRIDE to its own port's /oauth/token, so env must not carry the override (childproc refuses a start that passes on a TOKEN-named variable's value). HOME is CODEX_HOME, not the workspace, and GIT_DIR is /dev/null, so no file a tool writes in the workspace is read as the CLI's own git or home config (ASSUMPTIONS C11). The brief arrives on stdin and the JSON event stream is the result.
